output.name: learn
output.purpose: Capture actual user evidence separately from procedural experiences; curate scoped rules and verified artifacts.

criteria.description: Retain the exact visible user source; keep tool/assistant experiences distinct from user authority.
Select an explicit storage scope and generalize the reasoning rule with a legitimate counterexample.
Promote only useful verified lessons; report/audit and help do not mutate state.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Contract verification does not replace correction provenance, native ledger validation or semantic rule abstraction. Use the real native capture/rule/session tools.
